segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin mostly report the retinal cream is well tolerated, without redness or irritation despite the active ingredient, though one reviewer with sensitive skin and large pores says it made her break out.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry, aging skin describe a gentle experience with increased smoothness and softened fine lines.
segments.mature: Reviewers focused on anti-aging use the cream nightly for fine lines and firmness, generally reporting gradual, modest improvement rather than dramatic change.

concerns.aging: Reports on fine lines and wrinkles are mixed: some reviewers say they saw no clear difference even after weeks of use, while others describe visibly softer, less pronounced lines and firmer skin, generally after a few weeks of consistent use.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers find the cream hydrating and non-greasy, describing smoother, plumper skin; a few report dryness and peeling in the days after starting, especially before their skin adjusted to daily use.
concerns.redness: The new formula caused burning and redness for a couple of reviewers, and starting the product too aggressively led some to a few days of redness, blotchiness or peeling; many other reviewers, including those with sensitive skin, report no redness or irritation at all.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer describes the cream as an excellent moisture barrier that removed her need for a separate moisturizer.
concerns.spots: A reviewer using it on hyperpigmented spots on her cheeks reports only minimal fading after three to four weeks of every-other-day use.
concerns.blemishes: One reviewer with sensitive skin and large pores says the cream clogged her pores and caused breakouts, while others report no breakouts and one recommends it mainly to those without acne or chronically inflamed skin.

I always get nervous to try new retinol products because I have very sensitive skin. This product-so far- has been of minimal irritation. The formula is thick but extremely smooth and surprisingly hydrating. There is no off putting chemical scent and my main concern was to work on some of the more hyper pigmented spots I have on my cheeks. From about 3-4 weeks of usage, I've seen minimal irritation from every other day use and my darker spots seem to be fading minimally. I will continue to use as it seems like with long term use it will be effective. I received this product in exchange for a review.

This was my first experience with this brand and I'm glad I tried this retinal cream. My skin is aging, dry, and some fine lines. Most retinal creams can be quite strong where you instantly feel soke sensation or tightening, even stinging. I didn't experience any of that here. Very gentle, nice texture and absorbency. After some consistency in usage I did notice brighter , smoother skin. If you're looking for an affordable, and gentle retinal experience, this is it.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I've been using the Avène RetrinAL Intensive Multi-Corrective Cream for a few weeks now, and I'm really impressed. I have sensitive skin, so I've always been nervous about using retinol products, but this one is super gentle. No redness, no irritation—just smooth, hydrated skin. It has a nice, creamy texture that feels rich but absorbs quickly. My skin feels softer, looks more even, and I've noticed some fine lines around my eyes and mouth starting to fade. I also love that it's fragrance-free and doesn't make me break out. If you have sensitive or dry skin and want something that works without being harsh, this is definitely worth trying.

I received this product complimentary for testing purposes. I have been impressed so far by the thick texture of the cream and how it has minimal smell. I recommend skipping this product on days when you have sunburn or other skin irritation, as it can sting. I don't feel the need to moisturize after the product, as it is an excellent moisture barrier for the skin! I have noticed my skin is more hydrated, has more of an even tone, and my complexion is almost crystal clear! I would recommend to anyone who does not have acne or chronically inflamed skin.
